notes.title: The Halloween Event - Live 10/29 - 11/02
notes.content:
A Dallen Clicker Update? In Late 2022?! What is this!?

If you play Dallen Clicker Ultimate between October 29th - November 2nd, you will unlock a LIMITED-EDITION Dallen Variant. This will be the only way to unlock the character. You will still be able to play as the character after the event ends once unlocked, but if you miss the dates, they will be removed.

If you are looking for another game to waste your time, JaDa Fishin' is a free fishing/idler game, which can feel like a spiritual successor of sorts to Dallen Clicker.

We hope you enjoy this small event as 2022 comes to a close. Thank you for continuing to play the game.

- Dallen Larson, CEO of Larsonsoft.

notes.title: DLC PACK #1 Incoming!!!
notes.content:
Those who watched the GreenLeaf Studios: Video Presentation on September 17th, 2020, you know that Dallen Clicker Ultimate is getting 3 DLC Packs. Pack #1 Releases October 2020. We have more news on what that will entail here...

[previewyoutube=07I-k3zvxIs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Before we get into DLC Pack #1, we want to announce the release date of Version 1.0 of the original Dallen Clicker. It will be coming October 9th, 2020.

Now onto the juicy stuff!




First off we have an official release date for DLC PACK #1: October 16th, 2020.

This Pack Will Include The Following:
- Leaderboard
- 3 New Playable Dallen's (Dr. Dallen, TryWorld Dallen, Fire Dallen)
- Price Drop to $1.99 USD
- Fixed Saving Bug
- and a few other features you'll have to check out yourself!

As for DLC Pack #2 and DLC Pack #3 we are loaded with ideas on where to go from here. More information will be revealed for DLC Pack #2 in December.

We also recently announced on Twitter (@GreenLeafSLTD) that this will be the last Dallen Clicker game in the franchise. We have had a blast working on Dallen Clicker, Dallen Clicker Ultimate, and Dallen Clicker Ultimate Online, but there is no where else for the series to go. We will continue to improve on Ultimate in DLC Pack #2 and Pack #3 though. Thank you all for understanding!

We also have a few more important dates for you all to look out for!

Dallen Clicker Ultimate's mobile port, Dallen Clicker Ultimate Online, will be releasing Friday, October 30th, 2020. More information on where to play coming next month.

We hope you enjoyed this small update!
